overview: JCB Billing App for Matoshri Kamljadevi Earthmovers and Land Developers. A full-stack PWA for managing JCB machine billing, customer records, and payment tracking with real-time cloud sync across all devices via Internet Computer canister backend and Internet Identity login.
features: Bills stored in cloud canister — accessible from any device instantly
Internet Identity login for secure, private data per account
Auto-sync every 1-2 seconds across all devices
Offline support with local cache and sync queue
Batch export to PNG/PDF per customer
Payment tracking with NOT PAID / PARTIALLY PAID / PAID badges
Filter bills by customer, date range, and payment status
PWA installable on Android, iPhone, and desktop
